name: LRCLIB Synced Lyrics
author: afrolord892-ai
description: Fetches line-synchronised lyrics from LRCLIB, checks artist, title and duration, and falls back to plain lyrics only when enabled.

actions.name: lyrics.provide
actions.why: Find timed or plain lyrics for the current song

actions.name: network
actions.why: Request lyrics and verify the matching track metadata

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Choose whether unsynchronised lyrics are shown

settings.label: Show plain lyrics
settings.description: Allow plain text only when LRCLIB has no timed version.

changelog: First release. Exact-match lookup first, strict fallback matching second, with LRC timestamps converted to Myspoti milliseconds.
